about: Every message Aaron typed or dictated in this session on Terra (the PC), copied verbatim from its log on 25 September 2026. Only his words. Taken from both places the log keeps them - the queued record of every message he sends and the plain user records - each message kept once at its earliest time. Messages he sent while Claude was still working sit in time order with the rest and are not marked apart, because a queued record alone does not show that. System text, tool output, skill instructions, task notifications, cross-session messages, compaction summaries and anything the studio wrote are excluded, as are the helper agents' logs beside this one.
title: Game wiki and Obsidian vault design

messages.text:
I have a question for you about a potential build idea but you are not to write any code or make any changes in this coversation.

This game is pretty complicated with a lot of interconnecting ideas. I am almost going through a huge overhaul of design and was thinking that it would be good to have a wiki that I can pull up and read and because it would essentially be .md files I could create an obsidian vault that claude could write/publish to and I can see how everything interacts. How much work would that be and would it be able to be set up in a way that is also benefical to claude when programming to be able to store a lot of this data in a wiki and not in its memory
Sounds great - can you check the design brief - with politics done is the entire design phase complete

Write for me a prompt to give to a wiki designer who can take all of the information we got in rounds 1-3 and putting it together in a wiki that is both beneficial to me and future programmers. 

I think for me it will be able to pull up things when talking about them quickly and remembering what the rules are. The other is (and maybe this is wrong) I've heard of people using obsidian and claude to create a second brain to reduce on memory and token use on claude. (if that is wrong dont go into depth just say they are wrong). 

The other thing is I want to see how things all interact so everything will need proper tags and sub tags. I feel like this will also help us see how systems interact and if there are any things that don't interact.
I'll take it from here - do you need to sign off or not because no code was touched
